sheet_name: IUPAC World Chemistry Congress
conference: IUPAC World Chemistry Congress
method: Rung 3. The search only located the congress; the artefact was then found at zero further search cost by curl-ing https://iupac2025.org/ and grepping its hrefs for .pdf, which returns exactly one: the official Programme Book of the 50th IUPAC World Chemistry Congress (Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre, 14-19 July 2025), 36,768,452 bytes, downloaded to iupac.pdf. THIS BOOK LABELS EVERY ITEM BY TYPE, which makes the invited exclusion exact rather than estimated. ORALS: each talk in the detailed programme is printed as '<abstractID> (X): <title>' where X is the type letter. Count of unique (abstractID, type) pairs via re.findall(r'\b(\d{1,4})\s*\(([A-Z])\)\s*:') -> O = 516, I = 183, K = 90, and no other type letter occurs anywhere in the book. ONLY the 516 (O) are counted; the 183 (I) INVITED and 90 (K) KEYNOTE are EXCLUDED per the invited rule, as are the plenaries and the named award lectures (2025 Chemistry Europe Award Lecture, IUPAC-Soong Prize Lecture, PLENARY 3-6 etc.), which are printed with a speaker and no abstract ID at all and so are structurally outside the count. POSTERS: listed under 'Poster Presentation Session 1/2' as a two-column table 'Poster ID | Abstract ID — Title & Author', e.g. 'S1-PP01  1251 — A preliminary study...'. TRAP CAUGHT HERE: the poster ID S<cluster>-PP<nn> is NOT globally unique - it restarts per cluster per session, so a naive unique-count of S\d+-PP\d+ gives 392 (session 1 = 197, session 2 = 198, sum 395) and loses 3 to collisions between the two sessions. The ADJACENT 4-digit ABSTRACT ID is the unique key: re.findall(r'\b(S\d{1,2}-PP\d{1,3})\s+(\d{3,4})\b') returns 395 pairs with 395 distinct abstract IDs -> 395 posters. TOTAL CONTRIBUTED = 516 orals + 395 posters = 911. Cross-check per method rule: extracted twice, pdftotext -layout and -raw, and BOTH return identically O=516, I=183, K=90 and 395 poster pairs, so extraction is not lossy. ATTENDANCE: DELIBERATELY LEFT NULL. A 'more than 3,000 delegates' figure appears in search-result snippets attributed to iupac.org and council.science, but iupac.org/event/iupac-world-chemistry-congress-2025/ does not contain it on the page as fetched and council.science/events/iupac-2025/ returns HTTP 403; a python regex sweep of the programme book for 'delegates|participants|3,?000' finds only prose ('Distinguished delegates', a venue blurb) and NO headcount. Per rule 3 and 'never write down a figure you only saw in a snippet', it is not recorded. DECISIVE-ROW WARNING: 911 is 11 above the ~900 retention floor, so this row was re-derived twice and the poster collision above is exactly the kind of error that would have put it under (392 would have given 908, still over, but the principle holds). Biennial congress. Language: English (IUPAC is anglophone; host society IKM publishes in English).
